canonicalIdentity: SFEN board, hands, and side-to-move; move number omitted; no mirror or color rotation

hard_middlegame_endgame.predicate: positionIndex >= 24 and classifier is unclassified or furibisha (exclusive later-position residual)

historyIdentity: sha256(canonical initial SFEN plus NUL-delimited first up-to-24 legal USI moves)

selection.ranking: sha256(phase10-arena-start-v2 NUL seed NUL group NUL canonicalStateSha256 NUL positionId)
